courses.name: Bondi Golf & Diggers Club
courses.notes: 9-hole clifftop short course, par 28: eight par 3s and a 257m par 4 (hole 5). No tee times for social play: first come, first served (weekdays 7am, weekends from 11am, after competitions). Groups of 10+ book through the Pro Shop, 02 9130 3170. Green fees above are for 9 holes; 18 holes (two loops) is $35 midweek, $37 weekend. Club hire $20 half set / $30 full set; cart $45 / $50. HOLE 5: the club site (Sept 2026) describes the course as nine par 3s, and a July 2026 review says construction has temporarily shortened the par 4 to a par 3. If it plays as a par 3 when you are there, change hole 5 on the round, not here. No handicap rating stored: sources disagree (53.0/92, 56/97 for 18, 70.0/110) and none is Golf Australia's 9-hole rating. Take the scratch rating and slope from the card or GolfLink at the club. Stroke index is the 9-hole order from Offcourse, which matches BlueGolf and GolfingRecord; 18Birdies lists a different order. Distances in metres, from a course GPS app's "Mens metres" card (Sept 2026). The published card (145, 113, 121, 150, 280, 110, 163, 128, 134) is in yards: 18Birdies and mScorecard label those numbers metres, but the GPS app's metres are exactly them × 0.9144, and the OpenStreetMap hole lines agree with the metres. The GPS app gives a different stroke index (5, 17, 13, 1, 7, 11, 3, 9, 15 for holes 1–9); the club's printed card would settle which is right. Tee named white after Offcourse and GolfingRecord.
courses.source: Scorecard: 18Birdies, mScorecard, BlueGolf, Offcourse (hole lengths agree, total 1344 — yards; stored here as metres, 1235 m total, from a course GPS app's "Mens metres" card); fees and booking: bondigolf.com.au/cms/play-golf (Sept 2026); location: OpenStreetMap way 175817978 (ODbL, © OpenStreetMap contributors).
